entities.name: Egyptian Marriage Equality
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Ancient Egyptian women had unusually equal marriage rights — they could own property, initiate divorce, and enter prenuptial agreements protecting their assets. Marriage was a private contract (no state or religious ceremony required). Women kept their own names after marriage.
